joins: each Invoice to its Customer, on CustomerId (declared key)
measures: revenue: total of Invoice total, rounded to 2 places
planner_note: Sum 2013 invoice totals of USA customers per month.
text: Shows STRFTIME('%Y-%m', Invoice date) and revenue, by STRFTIME('%Y-%m', Invoice date). Reads Invoice and Customer, where Customer country is 'USA', Invoice date is at least '2013-01-01' and Invoice date is less than '2014-01-01'. Lowest invoice month first.
